Mobile app

The key in your pocket

Most of our locks run on Tuya Smart / Smart Life or TTLock. Manage the door from your phone and see who came in and when.

  • Remote unlock

    On Wi-Fi models, open the door from anywhere and see the lock status live.

  • Guest PINs

    Create timed or one-off PINs, so guests and service staff need no key handover.

  • Entry logs

    Who came in, how and when: the full history is in the app.

  • Alerts and battery level

    Get notified of failed attempts, tampering and low battery.

App features vary by model and connection type. Remote unlocking and instant notifications need a Wi-Fi connection. Screens are illustrative and shown in Turkish. Tuya Smart, Smart Life and TTLock are trademarks of their respective owners.
